Bug report: cooking bechamel today took the new milk (lot HD-1026) although lot HD-1022 expires tomorrow. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Fixed: stock was being taken from the newest batch first (sorted by received date, newest first). It is now taken from the batch that expires first, as docs/DATA.md requires. Batches with no expiry date go last; batches with the same expiry go by received date, then id. Added regression tests (the bechamel milk case now takes HD-1022 before HD-1026). npm test (28 passing) and npm run lint both pass.
